The '''Obran Cluster''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] cluster where the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had hidden cargo storage containers full of warheads. However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] learned of the cargo containers and placed a mine field at the location, intending to lure the rebels into an [[Battle of the Obran Cluster|ambush]] to inflict losses and acquire warheads at the same time. Despite the minefield and Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] lying in wait for an [[Battle of the Obran Cluster|ambush]], which the rebels were fully aware of, the rebels sent [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] to remove the mine-field and attempted to hold off the imperial forces long enough for their [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] of flight group ''Beetle'' to pick up the containers.

==Behind the scenes==
The outcome depends on which side the player takes.
